title: SmimeError::Der(der::Error) leaks pre-release der 0.8 type into public API
description: SmimeError in smime-tree/src/error.rs has a Der(der::Error) variant where der::Error comes from the pinned pre-release dep `der = { version = "0.8" }`. Any caller that pattern-matches on SmimeError::Der, or that calls .into() on a der::Error, must depend on the exact same pre-release der version. This is an implementation leakage: der is an internal parsing detail (CMS DER decoding), not a concept callers should be exposed to. What goes wrong: when der 0.8 stabilizes and bumps to 0.9, smime-tree callers who also use der directly face a diamond dependency version conflict. The fix is to map der::Error to a stable local variant (e.g. SmimeError::Cms(String) or SmimeError::Encoding) in the From<der::Error> impl, eliminating the variant that names the third-party type. File: smime-tree/src/error.rs.
close_reason: der 0.8 is a pre-release dep from the RustCrypto coordinated release (same as MIME-8zt.79). Wrapping it in a local enum would hide the error details callers need for debugging. Will be resolved when der 0.8 stabilizes.
